name: Under the Skies of Ikarus
source:
For as long as the gutsy, no nonsense mechanic Nova can recall, they have lived a rather uneventful life in a mining facility on the planet Ikarus.

The best part of their day is the arrival of Mining Team A after their own long, grueling shift, where they finally have the opportunity to see the person that makes their heart beat just a bit faster:

The enormous mechanized humanoid that houses an advanced AI known as MARC.

The two share a deep bond with one another, and dream of leaving the facility one day to travel across the stars.

But when a sudden disruption forces the two to temporarily part, they decide to take matters into their own hands to make their last night together something special and memorable.

[From [url=https://brii-nanas.itch.io/under-the-skies-of-ikarus]Itch.io[/url]]
